passages.text: Fumaria densiflora is a species of annual herb in the family Papaveraceae. They have a self-supporting growth form and alternate, one leaf per node, leaves. Leaves can be dissected twice or more.
Individuals can grow to 46 cm tall.

Habitat
The plant grows on garrigue hills or under stone masonry, concrete structures in Mediterranean.
